message.text: The interface is named `Driver`, defined in `store/driver.go`.
I already saw this while looking at the Postgres driver; I'll confirm the interface name and file.

q08.
Driver — store/driver.go

`store/driver.go` defines `Driver` as the interface every store database backend must implement (`GetDB`, `Close`, and the per-model CRUD methods). The Postgres constructor in `store/db/postgres/postgres.go` returns `store.Driver`.
